about_the_game:
The protagonist has long neglected a villa inherited from their late father.
While cleaning the villa to sell it to a real estate agency, they discover a hidden code beneath the kitchen grime.

As the cleaning continues, more codes are uncovered.
While solving the mysteries of the villa and their late father, the protagonist keeps cleaning—but something ominous is lurking…

Key Features

1. Real Cleaning Items Appear in the Game
Official Kao products such as “Magiclean” and “Quickle” are featured.
Some items can even be combined to unlock special cleaning techniques!

2. Discover Hidden Codes and Gimmicks in Each Stage
The villa is divided into multiple stages.
Use your cleaning tools to uncover hidden codes and find keys to progress to the next stage.

3. Beware the ‘Something’ That Stalks Cleaning Players
A mysterious presence in the game reacts to subtle sounds like your cleaning and footsteps.
Clean the villa while avoiding this threat and aim to escape safely!

Items Featured in the Game

  • Kitchen Magiclean Handy Spray

  • Toilet Magiclean No-Scrub Foam Pack

  • Bath Magiclean Air Jet Disinfectant EX

  • Quickle Wiper 3D Wet Sheet STRONG – Ultra Deodorizing

  • Magiclean EXPOWER Water Stain Spray

Estimated Play Time

60–90 minutes

Video Streaming Guidelines (As of August 8, 2025)

This guideline covers rules for posting or streaming gameplay videos online. Please read carefully and proceed at your own responsibility.

■ Streaming and Uploading

  • You may stream or upload gameplay footage without prior permission.

  • Please refrain from:

    • Uploading gameplay without commentary or reactions

    • Modifying game content (including via mods)

    • Uploading content that is illegal, offensive, or violates public order and morals

    • Infringing on third-party rights

■ Monetization
Monetization is allowed only through official programs offered by platforms such as YouTube, Twitch, and Niconico (e.g., YouTube Partner Program).

■ Disclaimer
We are not responsible for any troubles, damages, or disputes with third parties arising from the use of our game’s content in your videos.

■ Streaming Period

  • This game is available for a limited time until August 7, 2026.

  • After the distribution ends, the game may no longer be accessible or playable.

  • Videos recorded or streamed during the distribution period may remain online after the game ends.

■ Support

  • Support is available until August 7, 2026.

  • After August 8, 2026, you may still enjoy the game, but it will no longer be eligible for support.

  • The game may be taken down without prior notice.

  • The inquiry support period for this game has ended. (Updated on Nov. 16)

■ Important Note
Please ensure your graphics drivers are updated to the latest version before playing the game.

short_description: Move silently. Clean thoroughly. A 3D horror action and cleaning simulation featuring Kao’s real products. Clean the villa, solve hidden puzzles, and escape while your performance affects the home’s appraisal value. A unique blend of suspense and cleaning awaits.
